title.zh: Banks Want More: Trade Groups Demand Stricter Stablecoin Limits in Clarity Act
title.en: Banks Want More: Trade Groups Demand Stricter Stablecoin Limits in Clarity Act

current_state.zh: Eight banking trade groups urged Senate leaders to close loopholes in the Clarity Act's stablecoin rewards provisions, arguing that exceptions could permit interest-like payments that pull deposits away from banks.
current_state.en: Eight banking trade groups urged Senate leaders to close loopholes in the Clarity Act's stablecoin rewards provisions, arguing that exceptions could permit interest-like payments that pull deposits away from banks.
